formula: Unweighted arithmetic mean of per-utterance WER (statistics.fmean(errs)), NOT reference-word-weighted corpus WER. All256 rows had valid WER and retained.

paired_bootstrap.resampling: 256 paired row indices sampled with replacement per replicate; all rows eligible equally; no trimming or outlier exclusion

limitations: Single independently generated pair does not identify cuDNN causal effect; request scheduling, sampling and ASR variation are confounded.
Bootstrap describes observed paired utterance heterogeneity conditional on this pair; it does not estimate between-service-run/seed variance or hardware causal uncertainty.
Shared voice/speaker/context and any related utterances can violate independent-row bootstrap assumptions.
Unweighted per-row WER can exceed1 and gives short/long references equal row weight; largest contributors are descriptive, not exclusion recommendations.
Existing WER gate unchanged; no new significance/promotion rule, no rows removed, no scorer rerun.
No generated/reference text or utterance identities exported; only zero-based original-order row indices.
